guitar.notes: Jack White's red Airline JB Hutto fiberglass guitar is one of the most iconic and well-documented instruments of 2000s rock.

tone.target: nasal octave-fuzz riff with massive low end
tone.profile: nasal octave-fuzz riff with massive low end
tone.summary: A highly aggressive signal chain using a Fuzz distortion combined with an overdriven British amp model (UK 45) to deliver the required nasal, bass-heavy, single-riff tone.
corrections: Name octave fuzz, not generic grit

rig.name: The White Stripes - Seven Nation Army - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from the aggressive fuzz/low-gain signal.
Slightly push the signal into the fuzz/amp to ensure maximum low-end impact.
blocks.gap: The Boost is used here as a simple clean boost, simulating an initial tone shaping stage before the main dirt source.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core 'octave fuzz' sound and raw, aggressive saturation.
Simulate the punchy, mid-focused British amp tone required for a raw, dry sound.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is chosen for its classic, aggressive midrange character, fitting the 'raw' requirement better than smoother models.

blocks.purpose: Provide a punchy, defined cabinet sound that complements the UK 45 amp model.
Aggressively boost the low end and scoop the mids/highs to emphasize the 'big bass thump' and mono punch.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 allows for more precise, aggressive frequency shaping needed for this specific riff tone.

blocks.purpose: No wah needed; the fuzz and EQ handle the tone shaping.
blocks.gap: The riff is static and aggressive, requiring no dynamic filtering or sweep effects.

blocks.purpose: Provide a minimal, dry room ambience to give the tone space without washing out the raw punch.
blocks.gap: The 'small-room dry mix' clue suggests a very subtle reverb; Room is the most natural choice for this effect type.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by selecting an IR that emphasizes raw, aggressive low-mids and mono punch.

proposals.reason: Enhance the raw, bass-heavy thump and single-coil aggression.
